title: Lab overview
description: The whole lab at a glance: alerts, service checks, the hypervisor, every workstation, the servers and the automation. Dashboards live in git (roles/monitoring/files/grafana/dashboards).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alert rules (roles/monitoring/files/alerts.yml) that are firing now. The table below says which.

panels.title: Workstations
panels.description: Every workstation the lab keeps, by power state. Hibernated machines are suspended to disk and resume exactly where they were; they're off Prometheus's target list until then.

panels.title: Memory budget
panels.description: Memory promised to portal workstations (running or not) against guest_memory_mb. The portal refuses new machines that don't fit (lablib.admission).

panels.title: pve01 CPU
panels.description: The hypervisor's CPU use, all cores.

panels.title: pve01 memory
panels.description: The hypervisor's memory in use (VMs plus Proxmox itself).

panels.title: VM storage
panels.description: local-lvm, the thin pool every VM disk lives on. Thin: VMs are promised more than there is, so this real use is what counts.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Days until the first of the lab's TLS certificates expires. Let's Encrypt renews at 30 days left.

panels.title: Security fixes
panels.description: Pending security updates across every monitored machine (node_exporter's apt collector).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: What's wrong right now. Each rule's summary and first steps are on Prometheus's alerts page.

panels.title: Service checks
panels.description: Each service probed from mgmt01 the way a user meets it (blackbox_exporter): HTTPS with a valid certificate, LDAPS, Kerberos, AD DNS, and the public sign-in page on the VPS.

panels.title: Hypervisor: pve01, as Proxmox sees its VMs
CPU by VM
panels.description: Cores each VM is using, stacked; the dashed line is what pve01 has.

panels.title: Memory by VM
panels.description: Memory each VM is using, stacked; the dashed line is what pve01 has. Hibernated machines use none.

panels.title: Storage pools
panels.description: Proxmox's storage: local-lvm holds VM disks, local holds ISOs and backups.

panels.title: Disk I/O by VM
panels.description: Reads up, writes down (Proxmox's per-VM counters).

panels.title: Network by VM
panels.description: Received up, sent down.

panels.title: Every workstation
panels.description: One row per workstation the lab keeps, from the lab's records and each machine's node_exporter. Hibernated machines show no live numbers. Click a name for its details.

panels.title: $workstation
panels.description: One panel per running workstation: they appear and disappear with the machines (Prometheus's target list, rewritten by lab-metrics every 30 seconds).

panels.title: Key services
panels.description: The services the lab depends on, as systemd reports them on each server (node_exporter's systemd collector). Probes above check the same services from the outside.

panels.title: Clock offset
panels.description: How far each clock is from its time source. Kerberos (AD sign-ins) refuses 5 minutes; the alert fires at half a second. VMs freeze with their host and wake up behind (chrony: makestep 1 -1).

panels.title: Tunnel: last handshake
panels.description: The WireGuard tunnel from pve01 to the VPS: the internet's only way in. Handshakes renew every two minutes while the VPS answers.

panels.title: Tunnel traffic
panels.description: Bytes through the tunnel: visitors using the portal from the internet.

panels.title: Root filesystem
panels.description: / on every monitored machine.

panels.title: Pending updates
panels.description: Package updates waiting on each machine, security and others (apt collector, every 15 minutes).

panels.title: Reconciler last ran
panels.description: lab-reconcile.timer runs every minute: it applies the release branch whenever it moves.

panels.title: Last full deploy
panels.description: When the reconciler last ran the whole server configuration (site.yml).

panels.title: Release
panels.description: Whether the latest commit on the release branch was applied.

panels.title: Reconciler
panels.description: Paused while /var/lib/lab/reconcile.paused exists (docs/operations.md).

panels.title: Operations, last 24 h
panels.description: Builds, deletes, image builds and deploys (`lab`), by outcome. Unresolved: failures with no later success on the same machine, image or release (alert OperationFailureUnresolved). The admin page's Activity has each one.

panels.title: Golden images
panels.description: Age of each golden image (lab image build). New machines are clones of these.

panels.title: Workstations over time
panels.description: How many machines the lab keeps, and how many are awake.

panels.title: Memory budget over time
panels.description: Admission control: new workstations must fit under the budget.
